questions.prompt: Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system.
questions.explanation: Venus is hotter than Mercury because its dense carbon-dioxide atmosphere traps heat through an extreme greenhouse effect.

questions.prompt: The Great Wall of China is visible from the Moon with the naked eye.
questions.explanation: The wall is too narrow to distinguish from the Moon without magnification, despite the persistence of this popular myth.
Two hearts pump blood through the gills, while a third circulates it through the rest of the body.

questions.prompt: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
questions.explanation: Tall or isolated structures can be struck repeatedly. The Empire State Building is struck many times in a typical year.

questions.prompt: A day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus.
questions.explanation: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to rotate once, but only about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun.

questions.prompt: Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
questions.explanation: Experiments show that goldfish can retain learned associations for weeks or months.

questions.prompt: Sound travels faster through water than through air.
questions.explanation: Particles are more closely packed in water, allowing vibrations to transfer roughly four times faster than in air.

questions.prompt: Humans use only ten percent of their brains.
questions.explanation: Brain imaging shows activity across virtually every region, although not all areas are equally active at the same moment.

questions.prompt: Bananas are botanically classified as berries.
questions.explanation: A botanical berry develops from one flower with one ovary and has seeds embedded in its flesh; bananas meet that definition.

questions.prompt: The chemical symbol for potassium is P.
questions.explanation: Potassium's symbol is K, derived from the Neo-Latin word kalium. P is the symbol for phosphorus.
